jacob-sheep.context: A front view sheep head with four horns, two curving up and two curling down beside the face. Used for heritage livestock, rare breed farms and wool or petting zoo content.

racka-sheep.context: A front view sheep head with two long corkscrew horns spiraling upward in a V. Used for Hungarian and heritage livestock, rare breeds and farm content.

nubian-goat.context: A goat head in profile with a bulging Roman nose, a small beard and a long drooping ear. Used for dairy goat farms, livestock shows, milk and cheese content.

angora-goat.context: A side view goat covered in tight curly locks of mohair with backward curved horns. Used for mohair and fibre content, textile sources and livestock farming.

moose.context: A front view moose head with wide flat palm-shaped antlers, a long drooping nose and a dewlap hanging below the chin. Used for north woods, Canada, hunting season and wildlife crossing content.

musk-deer.context: A deer head in profile with no antlers, large ears and a long thin fang hanging from the upper lip. Used for Himalayan and Asian wildlife, musk, conservation and endangered species content.

fallow-deer.context: A side view deer with a spotted coat and broad flat palmate antlers. Used for park deer, British countryside, venison and wildlife watching content.

hoof-print.context: Two teardrop shaped halves side by side with a gap between them, the track of a cloven hoof. Used for animal tracking, hunting guides, nature trails and wildlife identification.

bear-track.context: A bear footprint with a wide kidney shaped pad, five round toe pads and a pointed claw mark above each toe. Used for wildlife warnings, hiking trails, bear country and tracking guides.

claw-marks.context: Three parallel curved scratch marks slashed diagonally, as left by an animal claw. Used for wild animal attacks, scratches, damage, horror and monster themes.

woolly-mammoth.context: A side view mammoth with a high domed head, a sloping back, shaggy fur and long curved tusks. Used for ice age, prehistoric and extinction themes, museums and paleontology.

woolly-rhinoceros.context: A side view rhinoceros with a shaggy coat, a shoulder hump and a very long curved front horn. Used for ice age, prehistoric and extinction themes, museums and paleontology.

glyptodon.context: A side view glyptodon with a large domed shell made of small plates, a small head and a club tipped tail. Used for ice age, prehistoric and extinction themes, natural history and paleontology.

irish-elk.context: A side view deer with gigantic wide flat antlers that span wider than its body. Used for ice age, prehistoric and extinction themes, natural history and paleontology.

deinotherium.context: A side view elephant-like animal with a low domed head and two tusks curving down and back from the lower jaw. Used for prehistoric, extinct animal and natural history content.

platybelodon.context: A side view elephant-like head with a short trunk and a long flat shovel jaw ending in wide flat tusks. Used for prehistoric, extinct animal and natural history content.

paraceratherium.context: A side view giant hornless rhino relative with a long neck, a small head and tall pillar-like legs. Used for prehistoric, largest land mammal and natural history content.

macrauchenia.context: A side view hoofed animal with a long curved neck, a slim body and a short trunk on its snout. Used for South American prehistoric, extinct animal and natural history content.

basilosaurus.context: A long serpent-like early whale with a toothy head, small front flippers and a fluked tail. Used for prehistoric ocean, fossil, sea monster and natural history content.

entelodont.context: A side view hog-like animal with a huge long head, bony knobs on its jaw and long thin legs. Used for prehistoric, extinct animal and natural history content.

sivatherium.context: A profile giant giraffe relative with a stocky head, a thick neck and broad palm-shaped horns like moose antlers. Used for prehistoric, extinct animal and natural history content.

cattle-skull.context: A front view cattle skull with a long face, empty eye sockets, nostril holes and wide curved horns. Used for western and desert decor, ranch signs, bones and danger themes.

quagga.context: A side view extinct zebra with stripes only on the head, neck and shoulders and a plain rear body. Used for extinction, de-extinction, South African wildlife and natural history content.

arsinoitherium.context: A profile of a prehistoric rhino-like animal with two huge cone shaped horns side by side on its nose. Used for prehistoric, extinct animal and natural history content.

uintatherium.context: A side view prehistoric hoofed animal with three pairs of knobby bony bumps on its skull and long saber-like fangs. Used for prehistoric, extinct animal and natural history content.

gomphotherium.context: A side view elephant-like animal with a raised trunk, two tusks on the upper jaw and two on the long lower jaw. Used for prehistoric, extinct animal and natural history content.
